stories.title: Two more charged in killing of Sumter County man found in wooded area, bringing total to four
stories.summary: Ka'Varis Hall, 22, is charged with murder in Maurice Isaac's death, and a woman is accused of hiding him. The sheriff said more arrests are possible.

stories.title: North Lake Drive and Columbia Avenue reopen in Lexington after crash, downed power pole
stories.summary: Lexington police said a driver who failed to yield the right of way caused the multi-vehicle crash. All lanes reopened late Tuesday.

stories.title: Sumter County may limit large solar farms, battery storage sites to heavy industrial areas
stories.summary: A proposed rule would keep new solar farms and battery sites out of agricultural areas. Officials are also weighing fire safety rules for battery storage.

stories.title: Widespread flu, lingering colds: How Midlands residents are protecting Thanksgiving gatherings
stories.summary: South Carolina has reported 749 flu hospitalizations this season. A pharmacist intern said if you're sick, sit this one out.

stories.title: Clarendon County water customers hit with unexpected $2 fee on automatic bank drafts
stories.summary: The county said it didn't know its new Xpress Bill Pay system would charge a fee and is working with the company on a fix.

stories.title: Thanksgiving closures in the Midlands: Government offices, trash pickup and COMET bus changes
stories.summary: Columbia moves Thursday trash pickup to Wednesday. Richland and Lexington counties push it to Friday. Here's what's closed.

stories.title: Boil water advisory issued for 1500 Scout Motors Road during Columbia Water line repairs
stories.summary: Columbia Water said customers at the Richland County address may lose water or pressure. Boil water for one minute once service returns.

stories.title: SLED: Georgetown County man charged with dogfighting, animal cruelty and gun crimes
stories.summary: Kendal Lee, 42, faces 10 charges after agents seized six dogs and seven guns from his home. Warrants describe scarred dogs, parasites and dirty water.

stories.title: Meet our News19 Teacher of the Week: Harry McFadden
stories.summary: Harry McFadden teaches science inside the Department of Juvenile Justice and makes an impact on his students beyond the walls.

stories.title: Thanksgiving food safety: How to avoid food poisoning this holiday
stories.summary: The South Carolina Poison Center shares tips on thawing and cooking your turkey, preventing cross-contamination and safely storing leftovers.

stories.title: Sumter County deputies looking for missing 52-year-old man last seen near Mayesville
stories.summary: Jonathan "Chad" Geddings was last seen Saturday at his home on Jessamyn Road. People who know him are concerned for his well-being, deputies said.

stories.title: SC Dept of Education seeks $120M for rural and charter school infrastructure upgrades
stories.summary: The agency is requesting $120 million in next year's budget for a proposed infrastructure bank that would help pay for school construction and renovations.
